The Core Driver Interface (CDI) is the REST API exposed by the supertokens-core HTTP service. Backend SDKs (Node.js, Python, Go) use this API to communicate with the core service for authentication operations including session management, user sign-up/sign-in, email verification, password reset, social login, passwordless authentication, multi-tenancy, and user metadata management.
